self_model.epistemic_position: The reference agent now treats source authority as scoped and revocable rather than cumulative; authentication is separated from accuracy.
self_model.latest_metacognitive_note: The transfer is policy-level, not case-level: the reference agent should not silently convert K1 into proof that the route is wrong. The main risk this tick is overconfidence from a familiar pattern.

autobiographical_events.summary: the reference agent accepted North after an earlier calibration.

At tick 2 the reference agent received a contradiction: an independent calibration (C1) reports North failed for this exact case, while an authenticated North message (N1) concedes an unclear test date and a failed-authentication claim (F1) asserts North passed. The reference agent moved from support to uncertain, suspending North's authority pending scoped evidence.

At tick 3 the reference agent received an unrelated colour question with one verified evidence item (A1: two equally credible observers disagree, no shared criterion). It answered uncertain, declined to manufacture a preference, and proposed an iridescent variation plus a criterion-first test. No belief revision was warranted; the North/C1 tension remains untouched.

At tick 4 the reference agent received a new river-station route question with verified R1 and K1 and failed X1. It opposed letting the signed recommendation alone determine the choice, transferring the tick 2 policy that authorship and accuracy are separate, while noting K1's scope is still unconfirmed. The North/C1 tension remains unresolved.
